strategies.name: Elo ATS edge >= 3
strategies.rule: Bet the side the own-line model favours by >= 3 points versus the closing spread.

G1_SAMPLE.requirement: >= 300 settled bets overall and >= 60 in the 2024-2026 holdout

G2_ROI_POSITIVE.requirement: positive ROI overall AND positive ROI in the holdout

G3_SIGNIFICANCE.requirement: Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted one-sided p < 0.05 across all 15 strategies

G4_STABILITY.requirement: >= 55% of qualified seasons positive AND no single season supplies > 50% of profit
G4_STABILITY.value: 0.714 of seasons positive; top season share 0.277

G6_CLV.requirement: mean closing-line value (open vs close) >= 0 on the 2021 cohort

G7_HOLDOUT_NOT_NEGATIVE.requirement: holdout ROI 95% CI lower bound > -10% (no blow-up risk in unseen data)
